description: Per-project OneDrive delivery target, resolved once via a real Microsoft Graph lookup (never guessed). Maps ProjectKey -> the drive_id/item_id of that project's Generated_TestCases folder. Populated by upload_to_onedrive.py on first successful delivery for a project; add a row by performing the same real lookup for a new project.

SAMP.resolved_via: Microsoft Graph: GET /users/{owner}/drive, then /root/children, then nested folder traversal to Generated_TestCases
